messages:
Jordan (Support): bumping an urgent handoff. SSO provisioning failing for a couple of high-touch trials. Admins report 'activation pending' even after SAML assertion succeeds.
Priya (CSM): which accounts? renewal risk?
Jordan (Support): MedCore (enterprise pilot, 120 seats, renewal TBD), AtlasAI (pilot, 30 seats, renewal 2026-09), and EmberOps (trial, 8 seats, trial ends in 5 days).
Liam (SE): symptom details? Any error from the provisioning worker?
Jordan (Support): logs show worker returning 202 but team state not transitioning. snippet: ```INFO provisioning: receive assertion; WARN provisioning/activator: state_transition timed out for team_id=tc_42 after 300s```
Liam (SE): sounds like async state machine hang. might be deadlock in activator queue after the queue refactor last week. cc @deploy-bot to check recent deploys.
deploy-bot: DEPLOY: service/provisioner v2.18.0 deployed to prod at 2026-03-14T08:12Z. Rollout: 100%.
Nina (CS Ops): CS comms plan proposal: 1) Notify MedCore + AtlasAI within 45m, 2) Provide manual activation steps CS can run, 3) Offer a scheduled onboarding session and a one-time service credit for MedCore. Can Priya lead customer touch?
Priya (CSM): I can own MedCore and AtlasAI outreach. EmberOps I'll call directly (trial). Draft note: "We've detected an activation delay affecting SSO-enabled teams. Engineers are investigating; we can activate your team manually in the meantime and book a walkthrough. Expect updates every 1 hour."
Liam (SE): short-term workaround: run admin console flow: Settings -> Teams -> Actions -> Force Activate. Also provide `POST /internal/v1/team/force_activate {team_id}` if Support wants API method. I'll generate scoped API token for Jordan.
Jordan (Support): please add the exact curl, and please scope token to just force_activate.
Liam (SE): curl example: ```curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer TEMP-FORCE-TOKEN" https://api.redwood.ai/internal/v1/team/force_activate -d '{"team_id":"<team_id>"}'``` Token expires in 2h. Don't paste token in logs.
Jordan (Support): running force_activate for MedCore now. will report acceptance.
Priya (CSM): for MedCore — they are very sensitive to disruptions. recommend SLO credit + 1:1 onboarding session with success engineer + exec update if they ask. I'll prepare comms and loop in customer exec sponsor.
Nina (CS Ops): timeline & owners: Liam - root cause triage and rollback plan, Jordan - run force_activate and confirm, Priya - customer outreach & mitigation offer, Nina - status page + update leadership. Check-ins every 45m until resolved.
Jordan (Support): MedCore activation succeeded; admin confirmed team active. AtlasAI force_activate ran but user sync still shows missing users. Investigating LDAP import step.
Liam (SE): investigating LDAP import; possible serializer mismatch after recent import optimization. I can push a targeted rollback of import serializer v1.4 to canary. @deploy-bot start canary for import-service.
deploy-bot: CANARY: service/importer v1.4-rollback started. Monitoring metrics for 15m.
Jordan (Support): AtlasAI users synced after rollback canary. EmberOps manual activation accepted on call. All three accounts active.
Priya (CSM): outreach sent to MedCore and AtlasAI with workaround and offer. EmberOps called and converted to short paid trial (they accepted). Good save.
Nina (CS Ops): status page updated: "Investigating SSO activation delays; manual activation and rollback mitigations applied; engineers monitoring. Updates hourly." Posted.
Liam (SE): will own the postmortem; initial hypothesis is queue refactor + import serializer mismatch. I'll document timeline and fix plan in INC-2026-112.
deploy-bot: INCIDENT INC-2026-112 created, severity=P1, owner=@liam_se.
Priya (CSM): next steps for renewals: flag MedCore as at-risk until next CSM check-in, consider a 5% credit in their renewal quote. I'll add to the renewal tracker.
Nina (CS Ops): capturing feedback: MedCore requested clearer SSO status in admin UI. Adding feature request ticket: UX-1453.
Jordan (Support): all good from support side. closing after postmortem link posted.
Liam (SE): will post postmortem and remediation plan in 24h, assigning follow-ups.
Priya (CSM): thanks all. I'll log customer sentiment and follow-up actions in the account worksheet.
Nina (CS Ops): comms record saved: https://redwood.internal/cs/records/INC-2026-112. closing thread once postmortem is available.
